meta_description: McGovern Landscapes in Liverpool delivers bespoke garden design, landscaping, and maintenance. Expert local gardeners transforming outdoor spaces. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Award-Winning Garden Design — Local to Liverpool
hero_subhead: Expert landscape design and garden transformation across Liverpool. From overgrown gardens to stunning outdoor living areas, we'll bring your vision to life.
services_heading: Complete Landscape & Garden Services in Liverpool
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, regular maintenance, or specialist planting work, we handle every aspect of your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your budget and lifestyle. We create detailed plans, source materials, and manage the entire build from start to finish.

services.title: Paving & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional installation of patios, decking, driveways, and pathways. We use quality materials and precision techniques to create durable, beautiful outdoor areas.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Expert plant selection and installation for colour, texture, and year-round interest. We specialise in low-maintenance schemes and sustainable gardening solutions.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal clean-ups. Keep your garden looking its best without the effort.

services.title: Artificial Grass Installation
services.desc: High-quality synthetic lawns that stay green year-round. Perfect for busy households and low-maintenance family gardens.

services.title: Fencing & Boundaries
services.desc: Installation and repair of fences, gates, and boundary treatments. We use durable materials and ensure every installation is secure and long-lasting.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We make yours worth telling.
about_para_1: McGovern Landscapes was founded on a simple idea: great gardens shouldn't cost the earth. For over 15 years, we've been transforming outdoor spaces across Liverpool, from modest urban courtyards to sprawling suburban estates. Our team brings genuine horticultural knowledge and a passion for creating gardens that work for real life.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we listen first, design second, and deliver with integrity. We'll never oversell you services you don't need, and we always give honest timescales and budgets. Many of our clients have been with us for years—not because we're the flashiest, but because we're reliable, fair, and genuinely invested in your garden's success.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic. Our back garden was a complete mess—overgrown, muddy, nowhere to sit. McGovern Landscapes came round, listened to what we wanted, and delivered a beautiful patio area with new planting. The team were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Best investment we've made in the house.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Been using McGovern for regular garden maintenance for three years now. They just get on with it, no fuss, always leave the garden looking pristine. Reliable, honest pricing, and they actually know their plants. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Eleanor C.

reviews.text: Had them in to quote for a new driveway and patio area. The quote was detailed and fair, no hidden extras. Work started on time, the finish is brilliant, and the space now feels like a proper outdoor room. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James T.
